name: open-zread-pi
description: open_zread 业务层（cli / Orchestrator / Browse / RepoAnalyzer / Types）运行在 pi 的 agent 内核（pi-ai + pi-agent-core）之上；原 agent-sdk 由 packages/agent-runtime 适配层取代。

scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:catalog && bun run test:agent && bun run test:agent:http && bun run test:provider && bun run test:analyzer && bun run test:blueprint && bun run test:pages && bun run test:tui
scripts.vendor:build: bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/telemetry/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/chord/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/ai/tsconfig.app.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/agent/tsconfig.build.json && bun run tsc -p vendor/pi/packages/tui/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:tui: bun run apps/cli/test/smoke-tui.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/render-all-routes.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/real-run-check.ts && bun run apps/cli/test/mock-generate.ts
